title.narrative: Pride on our Plates: Strengthening China¿s MSMEs through proven food waste solutions and behavioural insights

description.narrative: Overall objective: Catalyse reduction and better management of food waste in ChinasMSME hospitality and restaurant sector by using innovative approaches and behaviouralinsights to implement SDG 12.3.Specific objective: By 2024, 350 Micro, Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises (MSMEs)in 5 selected Chinese regions (counties, towns or cities) are empowered to implementsolutions to reduce and better manage food waste, based on behavioural insights anddesign. The intervention will increase MSMEs capacity, understanding, and adoption ofproven best practices, tools and methods - including successful interventions in Europeand tools developed for large companies, which will be adapted to meet MSMEs needs.

comment.narrative: Actual Baseline in tons to be identified in 2021.

The survey we did in 2021 about food waste reduction among MSMEs shows that 21 of the restaurants produce 5kg of kitchen waste per day representing the highest of the respondents 10 has no waste because they use prefab food 3 wastes 2kgday and the rest 4 groups of 7 occupies a waste of 50kg 30kg 20kg and 3kg respectively.Meanwhile plate waste of 16 of the restaurants is 5kgday 12 of them produces 15kgday 8 produces 20kgday 4 produces 50kgday. As most of the respondents main business is food delivery 12 of the respondents shows no plate waste.
